title: concept change applied to one stage only
signal: a concept flag is handled in one stage only; a research reaches the acceptance stage with 0 kept rows
cause: the flag was added where the bug was seen, not traced through brief to search, screen, table, acceptance and audit
prevention: stage-trace gate: scripts/concept-trace.mjs walks brief to search, screen, table, acceptance and audit and fails when a declared stage has no handler or no test

title: invented criteria the user never asked for
signal: an enforced criterion whose source phrase is not in the request; rejection reasons naming a rule the user never stated
cause: acceptance criteria were written at implementation time instead of derived from askedCriteria
prevention: traceability gate: every enforced criterion carries the request phrase it comes from, and the enforced set is diffed against askedCriteria

title: oversized worker task, no early artifact
signal: no file written within 20 min; a src change with no matching tests/<path>.test.ts
cause: the worker spec was a whole feature, so the worker planned and wrote late and a timeout left nothing salvageable
prevention: launcher contract and watchdog: the launcher refuses a spec that does not name the src files and the matching test file, and the worker writes code and its test first

title: acting on the wrong research
signal: two researches with the same question; a created research the user did not ask for
cause: the research was identified by similarity instead of by creation time and id
prevention: resolve-by-id rule: any command taking a research id lists researches by creation time, takes the newest one the user created and prints its id and question before the run

title: two gates collide on e2e port 4610
signal: EADDRINUSE or port-in-use in the e2e output; a gate run that fails only while another gate is running
cause: the e2e port was fixed and unowned, so the commit hook gate and the harness gate could run it at the same time
prevention: exclusive lock file in os.tmpdir() (frl-quality.lock holding the pid): the second gate waits for the lock instead of failing on the port, and a stale lock is removed

title: provider saturation by background loops
signal: no new rows in the model-call ledger for N minutes while the run is in progress; provider failure rate above its bench threshold
cause: background loops and the foreground witness draw from the same free provider quota with no concurrency budget
prevention: per-provider concurrency semaphore with a reserved foreground slot: the witness runner acquires the reservation or waits with a printed reason

title: worker launch fails on missing worktree link
signal: the launcher error itself; the worktree path missing from the launcher preflight output
cause: the launcher checked the model and the spec but not the working copy it was going to run in
prevention: launcher preflight: verify the worktree path exists, is a registered git worktree of this repo and has a clean node_modules link, and refuse to start with the missing path named

title: lessons from one research leak into unrelated researches
signal: the Results tab of a plot research shows improve-loop tweaks of a clothing-supplier research (e.g. brand-filtered category pages on Vinted), and the improve prompt of one research carries another research's mixed or harmful verdicts
cause: lessons were grouped only by piece type (sub-question|lookup|fact etc.) with no item kind, and every principle verdict (helps, mixed, does not help) was rendered as an instruction to the proposer
prevention: every lesson stores the research's item kind (brief/decision-model kind label) and LessonBook.forType only returns lessons of the same type AND same kind (kindless lessons are never shared); only verdict 'helps' principles enter the playbook (helpsOnly in propose); the cross-research principles card moved from the Results tab to the Loop tab and calls /api/principles?project=<id>, filtered to the project's kind — covered by tests/research/lessons.test.ts (same-kind sharing, mixed not passed, helps passed) and tests/server.test.ts (?project= kind filter)

title: listing-work rule marks analysis pieces as covered
signal: a "pieces covered by code on the candidate table, not researched" tree line that names climate, zoning, district or data-source pieces (plot research b7772e lost 68 pieces on 2026-11-11, most of them analysis), or concept check C18 counting such pieces as per-listing work
cause: listingWork returned true for any action verb (find, identify, check, assess, calculate ...) or any target word (items, distances) on its own, so "Assess climate suitability for glamping without AC", "Identify Portuguese coastal districts" and "Assess e bike accessibility to the sea" counted as listing work and were never researched
prevention: listingWork needs an action on listings: a for-sale phrase, a word that names listings (listings, ads, URLs, links) or an order starting with "List" counts on its own; any other action verb needs a listing detail beside it (items, priced, distances, a <=/>= bound) or a brief kind word; a verb alone or a detail word alone stays research. Covered by tests/research/treeaudit.test.ts, describe "listing work needs an action on listings, not any verb": the b7772e titles the 2026-11-11 removal line names stay research, the listed-for-sale survivors and the car research 0c750f listing pieces stay covered, and the D8.2.1.1 branch keeps its district and sea-access leaves

title: research data overwritten in place with no copy to go back to
signal: a research file with fewer pieces or kept rows than the day before and no snapshot, journal line or log error that names the removal; a "tree" or "edit" log line that removes pieces with findings; a user asking where their plots went
cause: ProjectStore.save overwrote data/projects/<id>.json in place on every save with no record of what it replaced, data/handoff kept only the latest state and the research log held messages only, so the start-of-run repair that dropped 69 researched pieces of b7772e on 2026-11-11 (328 -> 201 kept plots) left nothing to restore from
prevention: every save appends one line to data/journal/<id>.jsonl with its reason and the full content of every piece and kept row it removes or replaces; a save that lowers the piece count or drops kept rows without a sweep first copies the stored file to data/projects/snapshots/<id>-<stamp>.json (newest 5 kept); a save that removes a researched piece is refused with an error in the research log unless the caller passes userAction delete, re-decompose, restore or loop; node src/frl.mjs restore <id> [snapshot | --before <ISO>] brings a snapshot or the journal state back while the research is not running. Covered by tests/store.test.ts (a removing save writes one snapshot and journals the removed content; an automatic removal of a researched piece is refused; a user-reason removal passes; the 6th snapshot drops the oldest; restore brings back the node and row counts; journal replay restores a removed node's findings) and tests/journal.test.ts (diff, undo and replay on the real node and row shapes). Because the store refuses, a start-of-run repair may never drop a researched piece: narrowRegions marks an off-scope researched leaf covered (coveredBy off-scope, findings kept) and removes only unresearched ones, using the same researched() predicate as the store (tests/research/treeaudit.test.ts, and the engine test that starts a run over such a leaf without a refusal)

title: an excluded word matched inside a longer word and dropped the suppliers asked for
signal: a genuine supplier of the asked kind is missing from report.deliverables while its page passes every kind, anchor and wholesale check; the brief's not list holds a short word (retail, part) that is the start of a longer common word (retailers, partners)
cause: entityDeliverables dropped a page when plain(pageText).includes(phrase), so the excluded word retail hit retailers, the customers a wholesaler names; b2f5b7 lost brasco.nl and vintage-clothing-wholesale.com
prevention: excluded phrases go through the shared whole-word helper wordMatch (Unicode letter boundaries, whitespace runs inside phrases); tests/research/acceptance.test.ts "a wholesaler page naming retailers as customers is not dropped by the not phrase retail" uses the real brasco.nl row and the real dustfactoryvintage retail paragraph

title: an entity-list region rule that let every source through and said nothing
signal: brief.regions is set and brief.located is false, every source passes the pre-model screen, and neither the research log nor the delivered rows say that the suppliers are outside the asked country (b2f5b7: 54 of 54 sources admitted, 3 of 3 delivered rows NL/FR/PL for a CZ ask, no region word anywhere)
cause: onConcept returns true before reading any country when located is false (deliberate: for an entity list the asked place is where the result is used), and the relaxed rule removed the measurement together with the drop
prevention: when a gate is relaxed on purpose, keep the measurement: regionVerdict labels each source in, ships to, names or outside the asked regions, engine.onConceptOnly logs the count of sources kept from outside, and each entity deliverable carries its region label; tests/research/brief.test.ts "region verdict for an entity list", tests/research/engine.test.ts "counts and names the sources kept from outside the asked country" and tests/research/acceptance.test.ts "marks each delivered supplier with its region verdict for an entity list and delivers the same rows"

title: table limits set aside rows that pass every hard criterion
signal: 18 live imovirtual.com plots of b7772e (500-18,000 EUR, Portugal, sea <= 20 km, 10-12 camping months, all pages active) pass every hard criterion of the research, yet none is in candidates.kept: 7 at 500-3,800 EUR fell under the implausiblyLow MAD cut (4,439 EUR) and 11 at 17,000-18,000 EUR fell past kept.slice(0, MAX_KEPT) of the 1,453 rows that passed the screen (docs/audits/recover-b7772e.md section B)
cause: buildCandidates moved every implausiblyLow-flagged kept row to toCheck and sliced kept at MAX_KEPT without asking whether the row passed every hard criterion of the research (clean screen verdict, asked country, not gone, coast <= 20 km and >= 10 camping months when recorded on the row)
prevention: passesEveryHardCriterion exempts such a row from both table limits: implausiblyLow only flags it (the lowCut stays visible on the kept row) and the MAX_KEPT cut applies only to rows that fail a hard criterion; tests/research/candidates.test.ts "rows that pass every hard criterion are never set aside or capped (recover-b7772e)" builds real rows from the URLs and prices in docs/audits/recover-b7772e-urls.txt

title: server started without a heap limit and crashed on Node's default ~2 GB heap
signal: heap OOM (JavaScript heap out of memory / FATAL ERROR: Reached heap limit) in data/logs/server.out while the server was loading research data, on a machine with plenty of free RAM
cause: every launch path (frl start spawn, launchd plist, Windows logon task, systemd unit, start.command) started node with the default max-old-space-size (~2 GB on 64-bit), so a large research exhausted the old space and the process died
prevention: every launch path passes --max-old-space-size=4096 to node before src/server.mjs, defined once as NODE_HEAP_FLAG in src/service.mjs and reused by src/frl.mjs and the three service definitions; tests/frl.test.ts and tests/service.test.ts assert the flag precedes server.mjs in the frl start spawn args, each service definition and start.command. Note: an already installed launchd plist only picks this up after node src/frl.mjs install is rerun

title: a supported grade with no sourced fact behind it, and weak pieces never re-researched
signal: pieces graded supported whose claims are all assumptions: b2f5b7 D4.1 ("0 brands present") and D4.2 (six assumed SKU counts) stored as supported with attribution detail "0 of 0 claim(s) carry a quote found in the cited source"; a re-run of the same research never re-attempted its weak or unsupported leaves
cause: attributionSummary scored a claim set with zero factual claims as share 1 and passed, so the attribution check passed with nothing sourced and the grade ladder could reach supported; and engine.run reset only failed/researching pieces to pending, so weak and unsupported leaves were left as they were on every later run
prevention: attributionSummary passes only when at least one factual (non-assumption) claim exists and every numeric claim is attributed (share 0 and passed false when factual is 0), so verifyFinding can no longer grade such findings supported; engine.run resets weak/unsupported leaves to pending and re-researches them, keeping the previous finding and status and restoring them when the re-attempt grades lower by GRADE_RANK. Covered by tests/research/verify.test.ts (the verbatim b2f5b7 D4.1 and D4.2 findings grade weak, not supported) and tests/research/engine.test.ts (a second run re-attempts a weak leaf; a worse re-attempt keeps the old finding); proof counts over the stored b2f5b7 findings: old grading weak 6 / supported 5 / unsupported 1, new grading weak 8 / supported 3 / unsupported 1

title: the self-improving loop stopped on a plateau instead of running for the hours the user chose, and steered at a check already at 100%
signal: find-appropriate-plots-to-buy-fo-b7772e started the improve loop with ~24 h, ended at 2026-11-12T20:57Z with "plateau: 12 trials in a row...", resumed after restart 22:15Z with 22.8 h left and ended again 22:44Z on a plateau; the 22:25Z stall message named "At least 50 valid items" at 100% as the weakest check while the score was 0.807 and only 14 of 30 pieces passed
cause: commit 0edee7a made ProjectImprover.loop break on PLATEAU_TRIALS=12 non-kept trials, overriding the user's deadline, and stallCheck picked the weakest acceptance check by raw value even at 100%, so steering aimed at a check that cannot gain while the real deficit (pieces not passing) was ignored
prevention: a plateau only switches steering (the recorded stall flips to stalled, as the stall path does) and the loop runs until the deadline, the user stops it, or nothingLeftToGain says every acceptance check is at 100% and every piece passes (that stop reason says exactly that); stallCheck targets the lowest check below 100%, else names the failing pieces, never a check already at 100%; tests/research/improve.test.ts "keeps looping through a plateau while time is left", "never steers at a check already at 100%" and "nothing left to gain" cover it

title: the router learned per provider, kept calling a deprecated model, re-admitted a benched provider at full load and read rate limits as unreliability
signal: data/logs/model-calls.jsonl (1,351 calls, 2026-11-02..04): 38 calls answered cloudflare HTTP 410 Model has been deprecated over three days and 0 cloudflare calls worked; groq shows 36 of 111 calls failed, every one HTTP 429 or 413; a cohere HTTP 500 whose request id holds 413 and a cohere 422 saying generated are counted as rate limits; a provider's pass rate does not move when FRL_<ID>_FAST_MODEL changes its model
cause: OutcomeBook keyed on provider|purposeClass, so a new model inherited the old model's record, and purposePlan ranked first research attempts (fast tier) with the deep model; switchModel knew only 404 as gone and a 410 is not retryable, so a model that could not be switched got no cooldown; a lapsed cooldown re-admitted the provider for every waiting call at once; providerStats divided by all calls and matched the bare substrings rate, limit, 429 and 413
prevention: each model is its own arm (key provider|model|purposeClass, rankRole modelRole); modelGone covers 410 and deprecated wording, and a gone model that cannot switch benches the provider 24 h with the env var to change; a lapsed cooldown is half-open and admits one trial call; reliability leaves capacity limits out; tests/llm/outcomes.test.ts "two models of one provider keep separate posteriors, and the legacy key still works without a model", tests/llm/ranking.test.ts "rankRole uses p[modelRole] for the posterior and the shown model", "purposePlan research order uses the fast model's posterior, since first research attempts run on the fast tier" and "providerStats does not lower reliability for 429/413 and does not count \"generate\" as a rate limit", tests/llm/router.test.ts "the real cloudflare 410 deprecated error benches a provider whose model cannot switch, for 24 h, naming the model and the env var", "benches a provider whose deprecated model is pinned by an env override, and retires and switches the model when the provider can", "half-open admits one trial call after a bench lapses and closes on success", "half-open re-opens on a failed trial: 10 min after one compute error or one timeout, the normal cooldown otherwise" and "a second call waits for the trial instead of failing when every provider is cooling, and gives up after the wait limit"
